note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000. The economy was a mixed economy in the middle of the post-1991 liberalisation, with high but falling tariffs. The armed forces have always been volunteer. Civil liberties are rated limited because special-powers laws (e.g. the Armed Forces (Special Powers) Act) applied in parts of the country. The Information Technology Act was only passed later in 2000. Public hospitals are tax-funded but public health spending was low and most spending was out of pocket, so healthcare is rated minimal.
